hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; ext="${f##*.}"; if [[ "$ext" == "ts" || "$ext" == "tsx" || "$ext" == "js" || "$ext" == "jsx" || "$ext" == "json" || "$ext" == "css" || "$ext" == "md" ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "[hook] formatted: $f"; fi'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; ext="${f##*.}"; if [[ "$ext" == "ts" || "$ext" == "tsx" ]]; then result=$(npx next lint --file "$f" 2>&1); if echo "$result" | grep -q "Error\|error"; then echo "$result" >&2; echo "[hook] lint errors in $f — fix before continuing" >&2; fi; fi'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; b=$(basename "$f"); if [[ "$b" == ".env" || "$b" == ".env.local" ]]; then echo "Never edit .env directly — use .env.local.example as a template and set values in .env.local" >&2; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" == *"lib/supabase"* || "$f" == *"types/database"* ]]; then today=$(date +%Y%m%d); if ! ls supabase/migrations/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$today"; then echo "[hook] Editing DB layer — if this involves a schema change, run /new-migration first"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" != *".test."* && "$f" != *".spec."* && ("$f" == *".ts" || "$f" == *".tsx") ]]; then testf="${f%.ts}.test.ts"; testfx="${f%.tsx}.test.tsx"; if [[ ! -f "$testf" && ! -f "$testfx" ]]; then echo "[hook] No test file found for $f — remember to create one"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" == *"api/webhooks"* ]]; then if [[ -f "$f" ]] && ! grep -qiE "hmac|constructEvent|verifySignature|webhook.*secret" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[hook] WARNING: Webhook handler may be missing HMAC signature verification" >&2; fi; fi'

bash -c 'npm run test 2>&1; test_exit=$?; npm run type-check 2>&1; tc_exit=$?; npm run lint 2>&1; lint_exit=$?; npx playwright test --project=chromium 2>&1; pw_exit=$?; if [[ $test_exit -ne 0 || $tc_exit -ne 0 || $lint_exit -ne 0 || $pw_exit -ne 0 ]]; then echo "STOP_HOOK_FAIL: not all checks pass — iterate" >&2; exit 1; else echo "TASK_COMPLETE"; fi'

printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"AUTO-COMPACTION TRIGGERED. MANDATORY: You must invoke the gsd:pause-work skill RIGHT NOW before this compaction proceeds. Write docs/claude/handoff.md with full current session state (what was done, what remains, decisions made, next action). This is Session Protocol rule 2 from CLAUDE.md. Invoke gsd:pause-work immediately."}}'

printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"MANUAL COMPACTION TRIGGERED. Write docs/claude/handoff.md with full current session state (what was done, what remains, decisions made, next action). This is Session Protocol rule 2 from CLAUDE.md. Invoke gsd:pause-work immediately."}}'
